title: A key that changes font state must act only on something the screen shows
rule: When a keyboard or palette action activates or deactivates fonts, check that its target is visible: a selected row, or a detail view. A store value that outlives the row (a `?face=` in the URL, a last-loaded detail) is not a target, so disable the action when nothing is selected. When a story removes the pane that showed a value, list every action that still reads that value.
rationale: E41.5 (#451): removing the inspector left A and Shift+A acting on the face named by `?face=` after a search hid its row, so a registration changed with nothing on the wall naming the font.
